name: After § 21
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union agencies for the financial year 2024
part_text: 21 a. Points out that Frontex's expanded budget should be conditional on the respect of fundamental rights and transparency requirement, as well as the effective follow up to recommendations stemming from the Ombudsman and OLAF investigation, the discharge authority and the Fundamental Rights Officer;
